summary: Grimmory is a self-hosted media server designed to manage and read ebooks, comics, and audiobooks. It includes native metadata retrieval, multi-user accounts, an OPDS feed generator, and synchronisation capabilities for Kobo and KOReader devices.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters who want a dedicated, multi-format library manager to serve both web-based reading interfaces and external e-reader hardware.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence carries strict copyleft obligations if you modify and redistribute the code, and the platform may overlap with more mature media servers.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, so you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your media files and database state, alongside a reverse proxy for HTTPS access.
